description: A history state with a default target enters the default when it has recorded nothing, and what it recorded once it has. `Previous -> Editing` (shallow) enters `Editing` and its initial state, not `Doc`'s initial `Blank`; once `Doc` is left from `Editing.Review` it restores `Editing` from its start. `Last -> Pages.Second` (deep) enters `Pages` on the way to `Second`, and once left from `Third` restores `Third`. `Restore -> Main.Split, Side.Wide` enters one state in each region of the parallel `View`; once left, it restores each region from its start, as a shallow history state of a parallel state does.
